title: memory-audit
description: A repository's memory-audit configuration, governance/project/memory-audit.yaml (W2-204): the categories and their quotas for one half, the governing domains, the subsystems, the spread rule, the paths no question may cite and the control set. A closed set of keys. Beyond this schema, gov memaudit check also asks that the quotas sum to half_size, that nonexistent-id is a category, that no name is written twice and that every domain matches a tracked file.

repository.description: the display name the briefs use

half_size.description: the questions of one half; the quotas sum to it

categories.description: ordered: the table order breaks the writer's ties; nonexistent-id must be one of them

domains.description: the first row matching a question's first source path decides its governing domain

subsystems.description: may be empty; a row counts by path or by a key of the first source file's front matter

spread.description: per half_size: a domain needs at least domain_min questions, a subsystem holds at most subsystem_max; absent, 4 and 10 of 40 scaled to half_size

exclude.description: paths a question's source may never be in, and the briefs name as left unread

control.description: the control set measured before each attempt, or the word none

patterns.description: a pattern ending /** matches anything below the folder, a * stays inside one name, a bare name is that file
